title: AI资本开支烧钱：巨头融资压力隐现，钱从哪来？
speaker: Winnie Wu

segments.en: So I think for second half, for now, second half, there are a couple things at play. Global, like, what is this whole AI CapEx story, right?
segments.zh: 对于下半年，有几个关键因素在起作用。全球来看，AI资本开支的故事如何演绎？

segments.en: We're looking, we're following the US big-tax companies, CapEx guidance, people looking at their free cash flow situation to see the sustainability of that. People looking for new monetization opportunities, right?
segments.zh: 我们关注美国大型科技公司的资本开支指引，以及它们的自由现金流状况，以判断可持续性。同时市场也在寻找新的变现机会。

segments.en: Is there suddenly going to be some killer app or edge devices or physical AI that will drive another wave of this demand for upstream capacity? But on the other side, people also watching the Fed decision. What does that mean?
segments.zh: 是否会出现杀手级应用、边缘设备或物理AI，从而带动新一轮上游需求？另一方面，市场也在关注美联储的决策。

segments.en: Most of capital, right, things, you know, the capital raising for these CapEx is becoming more and more important. But back to China now, I think, you know, earning season is important, right?
segments.zh: 资本开支的融资变得越来越重要。回到中国市场，盈利季很关键。

segments.en: That's why some of the e-commerce platforms has been doing well recently, because people expecting to reduce the subsidy to quick commerce, hopefully will drive better earnings, whereas some of the other large platforms more in the media advertisement sector are still struggling a little bit, right?
segments.zh: 近期一些电商平台表现较好，因为市场预期补贴减少将改善盈利，而一些以广告为主的平台仍面临压力。

segments.en: So, you know, earning season, the dynamic is very important. But also coming back to fundamental economy, people are watching China's export, you know, consumption data.
segments.zh: 盈利季的动态非常重要。回到基本面，市场也在关注中国的出口和消费数据。

segments.en: First of all, we had kind of sort of k-shaped economy, very strong external demand, weakening of domestic CapEx and consumption. Is there any rebalancing of that or, as of now, we seem to continue the deterioration in domestic demand?
segments.zh: 我们看到了K型经济：外需强劲，但国内资本开支和消费偏弱。这种状况是否会再平衡？目前国内需求似乎仍在承压。
